verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document scoped API tokens or least-privilege API credentials that could be issued to an agent. Workspace, project and repo permission controls (bitbucket-docs-9) govern user access. Read-only deploy keys, mentioned only by a community user, are SSH repo-access keys, not API credentials. Both are adjacent controls, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
